lineup: Raul Pineda - featured drummer; additional Genetic Tones personnel not listed on the current ticket page
events.factual_description: Blues Alley presents Cheikh N'Doye & The Genetic Tones on January 7-8, 2027, with 7:00 PM and 9:30 PM sets each night. The authorized ticketing calendar lists $45 admission plus a $7 fee on January 7 and $50 plus a $7 fee on January 8. The announced featured guests are Senegalese vocalist Faada Freddy, Indian vocalist Swati Kanitkar and Cuban drummer Raul Pineda. The presenter describes the program as a blend of jazz, African rhythms, Indian influences and contemporary sounds. No additional Genetic Tones personnel are named on the current authorized event page, so none are inferred.

en.why_it_matters: The interest is in the particular conversation N'Doye has assembled: Faada Freddy brings a Senegalese vocal identity, Swati Kanitkar brings an Indian vocal tradition, and Raul Pineda brings a Cuban rhythmic voice into a band already designed around movement among African rhythm, jazz and contemporary form. That makes these sets a real cross-cultural ensemble proposition rather than a generic 'world jazz' label.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for one set if the first January weekend is open in Washington. Four performances make it easy to choose the least disruptive time, so this is a strong local night rather than a reason to reorganize a larger trip.

es.why_it_matters: El interés está en la conversación específica que armó N'Doye: Faada Freddy aporta una identidad vocal senegalesa, Swati Kanitkar una tradición vocal india y Raul Pineda una voz rítmica cubana dentro de una banda ya concebida para moverse entre ritmo africano, jazz y forma contemporánea. Eso vuelve estos sets una propuesta real de ensamble intercultural, no una etiqueta genérica de jazz global.
es.trip_verdict: Le abriría espacio activamente a uno de los sets si el primer fin de semana de enero está libre en Washington. Cuatro funciones permiten elegir el horario menos disruptivo; es una noche local fuerte, no un motivo para reorganizar un viaje mayor.
